title: Auto Model
what: Picks the model, effort, Fast mode and ultracode for every prompt, and compacts first when a switch would re-read a long chat

parts.label: Pick the model for each prompt
Pick the effort for each prompt
Turn on Fast mode when speed matters
Turn on ultracode by itself for big multi-file code jobs (runs many helpers, uses more of your plan)
Compact before a switch that would re-read a long chat
